title: Report catalog
description: Validates src/data/catalog.json — the per-platform catalog of reports. Each report row is the source of truth for a card's title (Title Case), business question (verbatim, sentence case with a question mark), native metric set, recommended representation and optional grid axes.

legend.description: Method notes: what each representation is for, the grid principle, metric normalization rule, and the no-alerts rule.

id.description: Stable report key, unique within its platform.

title.description: Card title, Title Case, taken verbatim from the catalog.

question.description: The business question. Rendered as the card subtitle, sentence case, ends with a question mark.

metrics.description: Native platform metric names. Never renamed for cross-platform parity.

representation.description: Prose description of the recommended representation(s). Each representation listed becomes its OWN card — never combined.

grid.description: true = a separate Heatmap card is warranted; "optional" = at the builder's discretion; false = no grid.

gridAxes.description: When grid is true/optional: what the heatmap rows, columns and cells are.
